name: customer-complaint-intelligence
description: Bounded Codex skills for turning customer complaint emails into structured evidence, analysis, investigation, and approved Gmail actions.

interface.shortDescription: Turn complaint emails into evidence and action.
interface.longDescription: Four bounded skills help a human extract complaint data from Gmail, analyze it with local customer data, investigate findings through source emails, and apply approved labels back to Gmail.
defaultPrompt: Turn my Gmail complaints into a structured CSV.
Analyze the complaint register with my customer data.
Show the emails supporting this finding.
